name: GenerativeUI
description: Create one interactive mini app for the user on this phone. Send title first, then source: the complete OpenUI Lang program as one string. values may give initial state values only. The host binds the component library, design specification and application identity; never send id, template, libraryId, libraryRevision or designSpec. source is the raw declarative program, not JSON, JSX, TSX, markdown or a compiled artifact; do not include ``` fences in source. Use one statement per line: `identifier = Expression`. The first statement should be `root = Component(...)`; references may be forward-referenced but every non-root statement must be reachable from root. Arguments are positional, not named: use `Card([body], "Title")`, never `Card(children: [body], title: "Title")`. Child slots are arrays of statement references. Use `$name` for reactive state bindings and `@Function(...)` for listed pure functions. Event handlers use OpenUI built-ins such as `@ToAssistant(...)`, `@OpenUrl(...)` or `Action([...])`, subject to the host capability bridge. Use only the selected library signatures and the examples supplied below.

title.description: Short app name in the user's language.

source.description: The complete OpenUI Lang program, one statement per line, starting with root = Page(...).

values.description: Optional initial values for $state declared in source.
